373.whatChanged: The debug build (release-debug) now ships the same release notes as the normal build: Settings → Version shows its changes and any data reset. A release build fails if either flavour's notes come out empty. release-debug is now a release channel: it is always listed and switchable in Settings → Version, without the previews toggle.

374.whatChanged: Each paragraph, list or aside with threads has one comment pill in the card's left gutter, fully visible, with the glyph and the thread count side by side and a "N threads" tooltip. It is the only marker: the end-of-paragraph comment bubble and the inline glyphs after highlights are gone. A collapsed card shows one pill with all its threads. Closing and reopening a thread no longer adds extra glyphs.
374.whatToTry: Open a review with several threads on one paragraph; check the pill, hover it, click it to open and close the threads a few times, then collapse the card.
374.caveats: Cards with threads reserve a small left gutter, so their text sits slightly further right than cards without threads.

375.whatChanged: On the debug build (release-debug) the top-bar update icon no longer shows when no newer release exists; it appears only for a strictly newer release and points debug installs at release-debug.
375.whatToTry: On a release-debug install of the current release, check that no gift icon shows.

378.whatChanged: Development only: the global-install check no longer reaches the real login service on the machine running it; every install scenario now stays inside its sandbox.
